text: When a family calls about a bill, it helps to know exactly what they're looking at.
This is Maria's portal. Her balance is near the top.
The portal shows what they owe right now.
Pay now opens the payment form.
Same line, same total as our ledger.
She can use a gift card here too.
A card she saved with us is offered here.
Or she can use a different card.
She types her card, and can choose to save it.
Then she pays the exact balance.

The most common mistakes are telling a family to look for an old receipt in the portal, when it only shows what's open, and a portal that shows nothing because the email on their record is different from their login. Remember: the portal shows what the family owes right now. For past receipts, email one from the ledger.
